sources.locator: Complete 9-page paper read. §3, equation (1); §4.1, Proposition 1, Theorem 1, equations (2)–(6), PDF pp. 2–5; §4.2, Proposition 2 and final finite-MLP limitation, PDF p. 5.

contents.name: §3, equation (1): data/generator log objective and generator/discriminator minimax directions
§4.1, Proposition 1 and equation (3): density-level discriminator objective and pointwise optimizer
§4.1, Theorem 1 and equations (4)–(6): optimized objective, Jensen–Shannon identity and equality optimum
§4.1 scalar maximum statement and JS nonnegativity sentence, including zero-density boundary cases and divergence equality
contents.reason: The paper states these facts but does not fully justify the (0,0) discriminator case or the nonnegativity/equality condition. The local A-page proof supplies both choice-free arguments.

contents.name: §4.2, Proposition 2: distribution-space convergence under enough capacity, an optimal discriminator at each step and sufficiently small criterion-improving updates
contents.reason: No distribution-space update theorem is authored. The source's assumptions are not transferred to finite neural alternating optimization.

contents.name: §4.2 final paragraph: finite MLP parameterization has multiple critical points and no theoretical guarantees
